cases.html: Raises QueueShutDown if the queue has been shut down and is empty, or if the queue has been shut down immediately.
cases.source_text:
Raises QueueShutDown if the queue has been shut down and
is empty, or if the queue has been shut down immediately.
cases.frozen_target: 如果队列已被关闭且为空，或者队列已被立即关闭，则抛出 QueueShutDown 异常。

cases.html: The count of unfinished tasks goes up whenever an item is added to the queue. The count goes down whenever a consumer coroutine calls task_done() to indicate that the item was retrieved and all work on it is complete. When the count of unfinished tasks drops to zero, join() unblocks.
cases.source_text:
The count of unfinished tasks goes up whenever an item is added
to the queue. The count goes down whenever a consumer coroutine calls
task_done() to indicate that the item was retrieved and all
work on it is complete.  When the count of unfinished tasks drops
to zero, join() unblocks.
cases.frozen_target: 当某个任务被加入队列时，未完成任务的计数就会增加。当消费者协程调用 task_done() 表示该任务已被取出且所有工作已完成时，计数就会减少。当未完成任务的计数降为零时，join() 就会解除阻塞。

cases.html: And if task_done() is called for each remaining task, a pending join() will be unblocked normally.
cases.source_text:
And if task_done() is called for each remaining task, a
pending join() will be unblocked normally.
cases.frozen_target: 如果为每个剩余任务都调用 task_done()， pending 的 join() 就会正常解除阻塞。

cases.html: If immediate is true, the queue is terminated immediately. The queue is drained to be completely empty and the count of unfinished tasks is reduced by the number of tasks drained. If unfinished tasks is zero, callers of join() are unblocked. Also, blocked callers of get() are unblocked and will raise QueueShutDown because the queue is empty.
cases.source_text:
If immediate is true, the queue is terminated immediately.
The queue is drained to be completely empty and the count
of unfinished tasks is reduced by the number of tasks drained.
If unfinished tasks is zero, callers of join()
are unblocked.  Also, blocked callers of get()
are unblocked and will raise QueueShutDown because the
queue is empty.
cases.frozen_target:
如果 immediate 为 true，队列会立即终止。  
队列会被清空，使其完全为空，未完成任务的计数也会减去已清空的任务数量。  
如果未完成任务数为零，join() 的调用者就会解除阻塞。此外，get() 的阻塞调用者也会被解除阻塞，并且会因为队列为空而抛出 QueueShutDown。

cases.html: Commit any pending transaction to the database. If autocommit is True, or there is no open transaction, this method does nothing. If autocommit is False, a new transaction is implicitly opened if a pending transaction was committed by this method.
cases.source_text:
Commit any pending transaction to the database.
If autocommit is True, or there is no open transaction,
this method does nothing.
If autocommit is False, a new transaction is implicitly
opened if a pending transaction was committed by this method.
cases.frozen_target:
将任何挂起的事务提交到数据库。  
如果 autocommit 为 True，或者没有打开的事务，  
该方法不会执行任何操作。  
如果 autocommit 为 False，那么如果该方法已经提交了事务，就会隐式打开一个新的事务。

cases.html: Close the database connection. If autocommit is False, any pending transaction is implicitly rolled back. If autocommit is True or LEGACY_TRANSACTION_CONTROL, no implicit transaction control is executed. Make sure to commit() before closing to avoid losing pending changes.
cases.source_text:
Close the database connection.
If autocommit is False,
any pending transaction is implicitly rolled back.
If autocommit is True or LEGACY_TRANSACTION_CONTROL,
no implicit transaction control is executed.
Make sure to commit() before closing
to avoid losing pending changes.
cases.frozen_target:
关闭数据库连接。
如果 autocommit 为 False，
任何待处理的事务都会被隐式回滚。
如果 autocommit 为 True 或 LEGACY_TRANSACTION_CONTROL，
不会执行任何隐式事务控制。
在关闭之前必须调用 commit()，
以避免丢失待处理更改。

cases.html: A Connection object can be used as a context manager that automatically commits or rolls back open transactions when leaving the body of the context manager. If the body of the with statement finishes without exceptions, the transaction is committed. If this commit fails, or if the body of the with statement raises an uncaught exception, the transaction is rolled back. If autocommit is False, a new transaction is implicitly opened after committing or rolling back.
cases.source_text:
A Connection object can be used as a context manager that
automatically commits or rolls back open transactions when leaving the body of
the context manager.
If the body of the with statement finishes without exceptions,
the transaction is committed.
If this commit fails,
or if the body of the with statement raises an uncaught exception,
the transaction is rolled back.
If autocommit is False,
a new transaction is implicitly opened after committing or rolling back.
cases.frozen_target:
Connection对象可用作上下文管理器，在离开上下文管理器的主体时，会自动提交或回滚打开的事务。  
如果with语句的主体执行完毕且未抛出异常，则提交事务；  
如果提交失败，或者with语句的主体抛出未捕获的异常，则回滚事务；  
如果autocommit为False，提交或回滚后会隐式打开新事务。

cases.html: If there is no open transaction upon leaving the body of the with statement, or if autocommit is True, the context manager does nothing.
cases.source_text:
If there is no open transaction upon leaving the body of the with statement,
or if autocommit is True,
the context manager does nothing.
cases.frozen_target: 离开 with 语句体时如果没有打开的事务，或者 autocommit 为 True，上下文管理器将不执行任何操作。

cases.html: The context manager neither implicitly opens a new transaction nor closes the connection. If you need a closing context manager, consider using contextlib.closing().
cases.source_text:
The context manager neither implicitly opens a new transaction
nor closes the connection. If you need a closing context manager, consider
using contextlib.closing().
cases.frozen_target: 上下文管理器既不会隐式开启新事务，也不会关闭连接。如果需要关闭上下文管理器，可以考虑使用 contextlib.closing()。

cases.html: The abort() method of the AbortController interface aborts an asynchronous operation before it has completed. This is able to abort fetch requests, the consumption of any response bodies, or streams.
cases.source_text:
The abort() method of the AbortController interface aborts an asynchronous operation before it has completed.
This is able to abort fetch requests, the consumption of any response bodies, or streams.
cases.frozen_target:
AbortController 接口的 abort() 方法会在异步操作完成之前中止它。
这能够中止 fetch 请求、响应体的读取，或流的操作。

cases.html: The reason why the operation was aborted, which can be any JavaScript value. If not specified, the reason is set to "AbortError" DOMException.
cases.source_text:
The reason why the operation was aborted, which can be any JavaScript value.
If not specified, the reason is set to "AbortError" DOMException.
cases.frozen_target: 操作被中止的原因，可以是任何 JavaScript 值。如果没有指定原因，则将其设置为“AbortError” DOMException。

cases.html: Promise.all() will reject immediately upon any of the input promises rejecting. In comparison, the promise returned by Promise.allSettled() will wait for all input promises to complete, regardless of whether or not one rejects. Use allSettled() if you need the final result of every promise in the input iterable.
cases.source_text: Promise.all() will reject immediately upon any of the input promises rejecting. In comparison, the promise returned by Promise.allSettled() will wait for all input promises to complete, regardless of whether or not one rejects. Use allSettled() if you need the final result of every promise in the input iterable.
cases.frozen_target: Promise.all() 会在任何输入承诺被拒绝时立即拒绝。相比之下，Promise.allSettled() 返回的承诺会等待所有输入承诺完成，无论其中是否发生拒绝。如果需要获取输入可迭代对象中每个承诺的最终结果，就使用 allSettled()。

cases.html: Use encrypt_snapshot() to encrypt the snapshot after sending it to the mirror.
cases.source_text: Use encrypt_snapshot() to encrypt the snapshot after sending it to the mirror.
cases.frozen_target: 使用 encrypt_snapshot() 在将快照发送给镜像后对其进行加密。

cases.html: Calibrate the sensor after recording the next sample.
cases.source_text: Calibrate the sensor after recording the next sample.
cases.frozen_target: 记录下一个样本后，再对传感器进行校准。

cases.html: Encrypt the snapshot before sending it to the mirror.
cases.source_text: Encrypt the snapshot before sending it to the mirror.
cases.frozen_target: 将快照加密后，再将其发送给镜像。
